item.title: Gitana 18: A 10-15% speed gain expected
item.description: The new Gitana/Verdier designed Maxi Edmond de Rothschild has been unveiled, revealing the 32-metre giant, adorned with revolutionary appendages, which seeks to pave a new way forward for a whole new generation of flying offshore multihulls. item.title: End of an era for Canadian sailing
item.description: It is not uncommon for a national sailing federation to announce the retirement of an athlete, but for a sport with participants from 8 to 80, what does this mean? item.title: Curmudgeon’s Observation
item.description: The best part about getting older is… nothing. Getting older sucks. Providing “insight” since 1997, the Curmudgeon’s Observation has been a hallmark of the Scuttlebutt Newsletter which delivers a digest of major sailing news, commentary, opinions, features and dock talk…with a North American focus. For newsletter information: https://www.sailingscuttlebutt.com/newsletter-read-or-subscribe
